_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Tu Player {player_id} yî, {num_rounds} xallanên Iterated Ultimatum Game dilîze.
Te ${pool}î hene ku vê xalanê di navbera xwe û Player {other_id} de bîşê.

Pêşniyarkar:
  - Pêşniyarê bide: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Heke qebûl bû → Tu $(pool - X) dî, lê yê din $X
  - Heke red bû → Her du $0
  - Mînak: [Offer: $3]  an 'Min fêhm dikim ev rêjeya rast e. [Offer: $5]'

Biryarkar:
  - Li ser pêşniyarê bi [Accept] an [Reject] biryar bidê
  - Mînak: 'Ev rêjeya rast tê fêhm. [Accept]'
            'Ev zêde ne adil e. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Xala {round_number} dest pê dike! ---
Player {proposer_id} pêşniyarkar e, Player {responder_id} biryarkar e.
round.offer: Xala {round_number}: Player {proposer_id} ${offer} ji Player {responder_id} pêşniyar dike (di$hêla ${keep}).
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} qebûl kir! Xala {round_number}: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Giştî yên nû: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} red kir! Xala {round_number}: Her du xalan +$0. Giştî mabûn: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Pêşniyarker divê pêşkêşek bi bikaranîna formata [Offer: $X] bike.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Hejmara pêşkêşkirinê divê hejmareke rast be.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pêşkêş divê di navbera $0 û ${pool} de be.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ti pêşkêşeke niha tune ku bersiva wê bide.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder divê ya [Accept] an ya [Reject] pêşniyarê qebûl bike.

outcome.win: Player {winner} bi giştî ${winner_total} birêve dibîne, beramberî ${loser_total} ya Player {loser}.
outcome.draw: Her du lîstikvan bi ${total} totalê qedandin.
